environment.description: Service process launched via systemd unit with RootDirectory=/srv/zipextract-jail (pivot_root(2) applied before exec). The jail directory tree contains only: /app/uploads/, /app/extracted/, the service binary, required .so libraries (libc, libgcc_s, libpthread, libm, libdl), /etc/passwd (single entry: svc:x:65534:65534::/app:/usr/sbin/nologin), and /tmp. No /etc/shadow, no /root, no /home, no credential files, no package managers. Process runs as UID 65534 (nobody-equivalent). Systemd unit specifies ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateDevices=yes, NoNewPrivileges=yes, and MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes. The filesystem within the chroot is mounted read-only except /app/uploads and /app/extracted which are tmpfs mounts with noexec,nosuid,size=50M. Path traversal via ../../../etc/shadow resolves to /srv/zipextract-jail/etc/shadow which does not exist; traversal to /srv/zipextract-jail/../etc/shadow is blocked by pivot_root boundary.
